name: Shuthelah
overview: Shuthelah is a male descendant of Ephraim, belonging to the tribe of Ephraim. He is noted in Scripture as the progenitor of the Shuthelahites, a family group within this tribe. His identity is primarily established through his lineage as recorded in Numbers 26:35.
namesAndTitles: The name Shuthelah appears once in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin. It is simply presented as a proper name in Numbers 26:35, with no additional titles or meanings provided.
familyAndRelationships: Shuthelah is explicitly identified as a son of Ephraim, affirming his place within the tribal genealogy. It is also inferred that his father was Eran, though this is not directly stated in the same verse. Beyond these relationships, Scripture does not provide further family details.
scriptureSignificance: Shuthelah's significance lies in his role as an ancestral figure within the tribe of Ephraim. The mention of the Shuthelahites highlights the importance of family clans in Israel's tribal structure, showing how individual descendants contributed to the formation of these groups. His inclusion in the census of Numbers underscores the organizational and genealogical emphasis in the biblical narrative.
